Description: At night, John Hobbes returns to the Study assigned to him and rests alone. After confirming there is no corpse in the room, he falls asleep and briefly wakes during thunder.
Location: Study（Study）
Key Information:
  - John Hobbes enters the Study alone and locks the door from the inside.
  - John Hobbes confirms there is no corpse in the Study.
  - John Hobbes goes to bed and falls asleep quickly.
  - Thunder occurs during the night; John Hobbes curses once and then continues sleeping.
  - This node clearly records John Hobbes’s solitude and the sealed state of the room at night.
Characters:
  [John Hobbes（John Hobbes）] Person No. 1, a visitor.
    · Returns to the Study at night and locks the door from the inside.
    · Falls asleep after confirming the room is safe.
    · Briefly wakes during thunder and mutters to himself, then goes back to sleep.
